lambda.snippet: GPU cloud that grew out of a deep learning workstation business. Reuters reported a $35B Anthropic contract in September 2026, and Lambda is reportedly raising up to $4B before a planned 2027 IPO.
lambda.origin: Stephen and Michael Balaban founded Lambda in 2012 as a facial recognition software company. It began selling GPU workstations and servers to machine learning researchers in 2017, then launched Lambda Cloud to rent NVIDIA GPUs by the hour, and cloud rental now provides most of its revenue. It has worked with Microsoft for more than eight years and now markets itself as the Superintelligence Cloud.
